content.value_statement: Choosing between AI coding tools can waste time, context, and budget when the task is unclear. This skill provides a structured framework for selecting Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or a staged workflow.
actual_capabilities: Classifies projects by codebase size and context requirements.
Separates exploration, focused implementation, hybrid, and deep reasoning tasks.
Recommends Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or a multi-phase workflow.
Accounts for budget, time sensitivity, and team familiarity.
Provides decision trees, matrices, examples, and a recommendation template.
Supports checkpoint-based handoff between broad exploration and focused implementation.
limitations: Does not run tools or inspect a repository automatically.
Uses documented context sizes and cost assumptions that may change over time.
Focuses on Claude Code and Gemini CLI rather than every available AI tool.
Requires users to provide task details, codebase size, and constraints.

use_cases.title: Plan Large Codebase Work
use_cases.description: Choose whether to explore with Gemini CLI before implementing with Claude Code on a large repository.

use_cases.title: Control AI Tool Costs
use_cases.description: Match tool choice to task scope so repeated development work does not consume unnecessary context.

use_cases.title: Teach Context-Aware Development
use_cases.description: Explain why different AI assistants fit different project sizes, task types, and reasoning needs.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Tool for My Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner tool selection for a known task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the tool-selection-framework skill. My project has [line count] lines, and I need to [task]. Recommend Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or a multi-phase workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Exploration and Implementation Needs
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate analysis for an unfamiliar codebase.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the tool-selection-framework skill to classify this task as exploration, focused implementation, hybrid, or deep reasoning: [task details]. Explain the recommended workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Phase Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow planning for a large repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the tool-selection-framework skill to design a Gemini CLI to Claude Code workflow for a [line count] line codebase. Include exploration questions, checkpoint contents, and implementation context.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Reusable Decision Policy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the tool-selection-framework skill to create a team policy for choosing AI coding tools across small, medium, and large repositories. Include override conditions for time-critical and security-sensitive work.

output_examples.input: A 30K-line Flask API needs one new endpoint.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: Use Claude Code directly. The project is small enough for focused context, and the task does not require full-codebase exploration.

output_examples.input: A 200K-line Django project is unfamiliar, and the team needs to understand authentication before adding a feature.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: Use a multi-phase workflow. Explore authentication broadly with Gemini CLI, create a concise checkpoint, then implement with Claude Code.

output_examples.input: An 800K-line legacy system needs an authentication migration.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: Use Gemini CLI for system-wide discovery and Claude Code for security-sensitive implementation. Maintain checkpoints for each migrated module.

best_practices: Measure codebase size before selecting a tool.
Use Gemini CLI for broad discovery and Claude Code for focused reasoning-heavy changes.
Create checkpoint documents before moving from exploration to implementation.
anti_patterns: Using a large-context exploration tool for a small focused change.
Trying to understand a very large unknown codebase with only selective context.
Skipping cost, time, and expertise constraints when recommending a tool.

faq.question: Does this skill execute Claude Code or Gemini CLI?
faq.answer: No. It provides selection guidance and workflow templates only.

faq.question: When should I choose Claude Code?
faq.answer: Choose Claude Code for focused implementation, deep reasoning, time-critical fixes, and smaller repositories.

faq.question: When should I choose Gemini CLI?
faq.answer: Choose Gemini CLI for broad exploration of large or unfamiliar codebases where full context matters.

faq.question: What is a multi-phase workflow?
faq.answer: It means using Gemini CLI to explore broadly, saving a concise checkpoint, then using Claude Code to implement.

faq.question: Can the framework support new AI tools?
faq.answer: Yes. The same decision factors can be updated with new context windows, prices, and model capabilities.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide codebase size, task description, urgency, budget constraints, and your familiarity with the codebase.
